versions.short: The bill would require the Department of Homeland Security to repeat its threat analysis of the northern border every 3 years, adding a review of recent changes in the number and makeup of people apprehended there. It would require an update to the department's northern border strategy within 18 months of enactment and every 5 years after, and a classified briefing for Congress within 30 days of each threat analysis. It would also require the department to develop performance measures for how well its air and marine operations secure the northern border between ports of entry. The bill states that no additional funds are authorized for these purposes.
